about: M10 prelude (P10, plan §7.4 rules 13 and 14): the frame in force and tool centre point control on a 3+2 and five-axis program. CYCLE800() clears the swivel (frameWithoutValues), a CYCLE800 with values opens it, and TRAORI is tool centre point control, not a frame: TRAFOOF ends it. The X, Y and Z under TRAORI are the tool tip in the workpiece, which is why a block there can be judged.

states.about: TRAFOOF at the top ends what was not on: nothing changes.
CYCLE800() with no arguments clears the swivel, it opens nothing.
The 3+2 moves are inside the swivelled frame.
A simultaneous move of A and C under tool centre point control.
